correctness.rationale: All-parameter proof: the nine-vertex block lower bound forces exactly six selections per block at optimality. Exactly four balanced involution omissions and three one-empty-row patterns exhaust possible local states. All edge boundary types are classified by six permissible corner flag pairs; recursion is bijective under recursive gluing and final boundary filtration. Direct literal graph enumeration independently confirms M_3=10 and M_4=6656, with exact integer recurrence through M_6. No finite experiment substitutes for the induction.

value.rationale: Complete all-depth optimal-solution enumeration for a natural infinite, recursively self-similar graph family. Separates a previously known extremal cardinality and exponential lower-bound construction from the full distribution of optimizer configurations, and gives exact large-depth values by a fixed 64-state recurrence. The depth-four exact count 6656 versus the previously guaranteed 64 illustrates a mathematically substantial missing contribution.
